item.text: {"text":"Use Tier 2 architectural deepening, modifying only model_design by adding a learned mixture of intermediate NextItNet block outputs. The latest gated-convolution model achieved validation HR@10 of 0.615, below the reported best of 0.625, so another architectural experiment is warranted. The hypothesis is that reading only the deepest block loses useful short-range transition signals as successive convolutions transform the sequence representation. In NextItNetModel, retain each block’s output and combine these representations using trainable, input-independent scalar weights normalized with softmax across depth. Initialize the weights to favor the final block while allowing training to increase contributions from earlier blocks. Apply the existing final normalization and padding mask to the mixed representation, and use it consistently through encode_sequence for training and candidate scoring. This adds one depth-aggregation mechanism while preserving causal dilated convolutions, existing block internals, public interfaces, and all eight hyperparameters. Allocate one candidate slot to this controlled experiment, leaving the frozen host unchanged and retaining the modification only if host validation HR@10 exceeds 0.625."}
